title: Bag (Backpack)
summary: The Bag is every player's network-wide inventory of collectible items - trophies from each gamemode, temporary coin boosts, keys and crafting materials, and openable pocket bags and crates. It is backed by NetworkCore, so an item won on one server (say, a trophy from Diamond Trophy) shows up in the same bag when the player is standing in the Hub. It opens straight onto what you own, and a crate opens with one click. Cosmetics and crafting used to live in the Bag but have since moved to their own systems.
how_it_works: The Bag opens on one flat, paged list of the items you actually own, sorted by what you can do with them: crates and pocket bags first, then boosts, then keys, blueprints and crafting materials, and trophies and souvenirs last. Left-clicking a crate or pocket bag goes straight to its opening screen (which shows the crate, the key it needs and how many you hold, and a ribbon to click), shift-clicking opens the whole stack at once, and right-clicking shows the item's details and drop rates. Everything else opens its detail screen on any click. A filter in the side column narrows the list to Crates & Bags, Boosts, Keys & Materials or Keepsakes (left-click cycles forward, right-click back); the Boosts and Keys & Materials cards on the left rail are shortcuts to those slices. Items you have not found yet are not shown by default: clicking your head card opens the Collection log, which lists everything there is to collect under the current filter, owned items in colour and the rest greyed out with a hint for how to get them. An empty bag says where items come from and links to that log. The Crafting Altar card shows what you have crafting and whether anything is ready. The detail screen has the item's description, rarity, how-to-get text and up to two action buttons: a primary action (Open for a pocket bag or crate, Activate for a boost) and, for containers owned in bulk, an 'Open All' that opens several at once (asking for confirmation first above a threshold, so a mis-click can't burn a stack of keys). Opening a container is fully resolved before the reveal animation starts - drops are granted immediately, so closing the window early or disconnecting never costs a reward, and a chat message always lists what was received. Duplicate non-stackable items are automatically converted into bonus coins instead of being lost. A coin boost, once activated, multiplies coin earnings from hub activities for a set duration; activating a second copy of the same boost extends the remaining time rather than stacking the multiplier, so a '2x coins' boost always means exactly double, never quadruple.
how_to_access: Open the Bag with /bag (aliases /backpack, /inv), or from the profile menu's Backpack button.

open_questions: A large set of additional bag items (52 picked from a draft catalogue - mostly cosmetics, which are out of scope here, plus two new crate tiers) is specced but explicitly not implemented yet, so it is left out of this data set entirely.

Diamond Trophy, Elevator Chaos, Mace Crush and Survival game items are defined in the Bag but, other than being visible as uncollected in the collection log, are not yet actually being granted to players by those gamemodes - only the Hub's three game items (Parkour Medal, Arena Dog Tag, Daily Charm) are confirmed obtainable today.
